title: A recipe for kimchi fried rice
prompt: A recipe for kimchi fried rice: ingredients as a list, steps in order, and the cooking time.

items.label: Optional: diced spam, ham or tofu
Prep
items.description: Chop the kimchi coarse and break up any clumps of cold rice with your hands.

items.label: Sauté the kimchi
items.description: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Fry the kimchi 2 minutes until caramelized; add gochugaru.

items.label: Add the rice
items.description: Add rice, kimchi juice and soy sauce. Toss 3–4 minutes, pressing and flipping, until grains are coated and slightly crispy.

items.label: Season
items.description: Stir in sugar and half the scallions. Taste and add a splash more kimchi juice if needed.

items.label: Fry the eggs
items.description: Push the rice aside, add remaining oil and fry the eggs sunny-side up, edges crisp.

items.label: Serve
items.description: Plate the rice, top with an egg, scatter sesame seeds and scallions. Drizzle sesame oil.

components.text: Cold, day-old rice fries best; fresh steamed rice turns mushy. Cooked times are illustrative.
